## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` passes (samples, reference docs, format, lint, typecheck, unit tests with coverage)
- [ ] `bun run test:browser` and `bun run test:e2e` pass, if rendering or the components changed
- [ ] New behavior has tests
- [ ] Docs and the README are updated (`apps/docs/docs/reference` lists every new component, prop and type), and `bun run sync:samples` was run if their code samples changed
- [ ] `packages/vue-docx-document/CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`
